examples.chinese: 啊！今天是你的生日。生日快樂！
examples.pinyin: Ā! Jīntiān shì nǐ de shēngrì. Shēngrì kuàilè!
examples.english: Ah! It is your birthday today. Happy birthday!

examples.chinese: 明天是九月二十三號……啊！是妳的生日！
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì jiǔ yuè èrshísān hào... Ā! Shì nǐ de shēngrì!
examples.english: It is September 23rd tomorrow...Ah! It is your birthday!

examples.chinese: A:中明，請問學校圖書館幾點關？ B:你不知道啊？圖書館晚上九點關 。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhōngmíng, qǐngwèn xuéxiào túshūguǎn jǐ diǎn guān? B: Nǐ bù zhīdào a? Túshūguǎn wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: A: Zhongming, may I ask what time the school library closes? B: You don't know? The library closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 經理說，我們要一邊說笑話一邊介紹機器的功能，這樣子才賣得好。小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō, wǒmen yào yībiān shuō xiàohua yībiān jièshào jīqì de gōngnéng, zhèyàngzi cái mài de hǎo. Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yīge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
examples.english: The manager said, we need to tell jokes while introducing the machine's functions, this way it will sell well. Xiao Jian is a caring and polite person; a man like this, you should hold on to him!

examples.chinese: 他做事的態度很差，而且一不高興就罵人，誰受得了這種人啊！
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì de tàidù hěn chà, érqiě yí bù gāoxìng jiù mà rén, shéi shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng rén a!
examples.english: His attitude toward work is very bad, and whenever he is unhappy he scolds people; who can tolerate this kind of person!

examples.chinese: 哥哥的想法很不實際，他一直想找一份錢多、事少、離家近的工作，但這種工作很難找啊！
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xiǎngfǎ hěn bù shíjì, tā yīzhí xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn qián duō, shì shǎo, lí jiā jìn de gōngzuò, dàn zhè zhǒng gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo a!
examples.english: My older brother's way of thinking is very impractical; he keeps wanting to find a job with lots of money, little work, and close to home, but that kind of job is hard to find!

examples.chinese: 麗麗的老公在她生日那天，送了她九十九朵玫瑰花，好浪漫啊！
examples.pinyin: Lìlì de lǎogōng zài tā shēngrì nà tiān, sòng le tā jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, hǎo làngmàn a!
examples.english: Lili's husband gave her ninety-nine roses on her birthday; how romantic!

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想喝什麼？咖啡還是茶？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng hē shénme? Kāfēi háishì chá?
examples.english: Okay! What would you like to drink? Coffee or tea?

examples.chinese: 好啊！你想去哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a! Nǐ xiǎng qù nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Sounds great! Where do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 有啊！他們有很多種冰淇淋。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu a! Tāmen yǒu hěn duō zhǒng bīngqílín.
examples.english: Oh, yeah. They have lots of kinds of ice cream.

examples.chinese: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。
examples.pinyin: A! Zài zhèlǐ! Qiánbāo zài wǒ de shū xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Ah! There it is! The wallet is under my book.

examples.chinese: 好啊。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo a.
examples.english: Okay.

examples.chinese: 啊！上課了！我們先上課吧。
examples.pinyin: A! Shàngkè le! Wǒmen xiān shàngkè ba.
examples.english: Ah! The class has started! Let’s go to class now.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 妳胖了嗎？我不覺得啊，我跟妳一起去看。我也想去買今年夏天的新衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ pàng le ma? Wǒ bù juéde a, wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù kàn. Wǒ yě xiǎng qù mǎi jīnnián xiàtiān de xīn yīfu.
examples.english: Have you gained weight? I don’t think so. I can go check with you. I would like to buy the new summer collections.

examples.chinese: 是啊，我想買一雙黑色的。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, wǒ xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng hēisè de.
examples.english: Yes, I would like to buy a pair of black ones.

examples.chinese: 對啊！聽說我們學校感冒、發燒的學生很多。
examples.pinyin: Duì a! Tīngshuō wǒmen xuéxiào gǎnmào, fāshāo de xuéshēng hěn duō.
examples.english: Right! I heard that many students from my school have a cold and fever.

examples.chinese: 真的啊？好有趣！
examples.pinyin: Zhēnde ā? Hǎo yǒuqù!
examples.english: Really? So interesting!

examples.chinese: 請給我一杯綠茶。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi lǜchá.
examples.english: Please give me a cup of green tea.

examples.chinese: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: We would to have a cup of black tea and a cup of green tea. How much does that cost altogether?

examples.chinese: A:我要去三樓找友美？ B:好。對了，這杯咖啡請你給她，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: A: Wǒ yào qù sān lóu zhǎo Yǒuměi? B: Hǎo. Duìle, zhè bēi kāfēi qǐng nǐ gěi tā, hǎo ma?
examples.english: A: I'm going to the third floor to look for Yumi? B: Okay. By the way, please give her this cup of coffee, okay?

examples.chinese: 中文老師每天都給我們作業。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngwén lǎoshī měi tiān dōu gěi wǒmen zuòyè.
examples.english: The Chinese teacher gives us homework every day.

examples.chinese: 我打電話給她，她沒接，可能在睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi tā, tā méi jiē, kěnéng zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: I called her, she didn't answer; she's probably sleeping.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，想給老師打電話，跟他說我不能去上課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng gěi lǎoshī dǎ diànhuà, gēn tā shuō wǒ bù néng qù shàngkè.
examples.english: I caught a cold; I want to call the teacher to tell him I can't go to class.

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: 我常常用中文給台灣朋友寫信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng yòng Zhōngwén gěi Táiwān péngyǒu xiě xìn.
examples.english: I often write letters to Taiwanese friends in Chinese.

examples.chinese: 十分鐘以前我給他打了一個電話。
examples.pinyin: Shí fēnzhōng yǐqián wǒ gěi tā dǎ le yí ge diànhuà.
examples.english: Ten minutes ago, I gave him a phone call.

examples.chinese: 聽說這家工廠的工人都很辛苦，可是老闆給的錢不多。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō zhè jiā gōngchǎng de gōngrén dōu hěn xīnkǔ, kěshì lǎobǎn gěi de qián bù duō.
examples.english: I heard that the workers at this factory all work very hard, but the money the boss gives is not much.

examples.chinese: 他今天給我介紹了一個新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā jīntiān gěi wǒ jièshào le yí ge xīn péngyou.
examples.english: Today he introduced a new friend to me.

examples.chinese: 明天是老師的生日，我們要送他一個大蛋糕，給他過生日。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shì lǎoshī de shēngrì, wǒmen yào sòng tā yī gè dà dàngāo, gěi tā guò shēngrì.
examples.english: Tomorrow is the teacher's birthday, we will give him a big cake to celebrate his birthday.

examples.chinese: 我們今天要學第十五課，老師會給我們介紹十二生肖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jīntiān yào xué dì shíwǔ kè, lǎoshī huì gěi wǒmen jièshào shí'èr shēngxiào.
examples.english: Today we are going to study Lesson 15; the teacher will introduce the twelve zodiac signs to us.

examples.chinese: 你先幫我付，我明天再給你錢。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiān bāng wǒ fù, wǒ míngtiān zài gěi nǐ qián.
examples.english: You pay for me first; I'll give you the money tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 那個演員非常喜歡演戲，不管導演給他多麼難演的角色，他都願意試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge yǎnyuán fēicháng xǐhuan yǎnxì, bùguǎn dǎoyǎn gěi tā duōme nán yǎn de juésè, tā dōu yuànyì shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That actor really loves acting; no matter how difficult a role the director gives him, he is willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 小黃要去便利商店領錢， 我請他幫我買杯咖啡。老闆去歐洲旅遊回來，買了荷蘭傳統的點心送給大家，叫我們去助理那裡領。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Huáng yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng qián, wǒ qǐng tā bāng wǒ mǎi bēi kāfēi. Lǎobǎn qù Ōuzhōu lǚyóu huílái, mǎile Hélán chuántǒng de diǎnxin sòng gěi dàjiā, jiào wǒmen qù zhùlǐ nàlǐ lǐng.
examples.english: Xiao Huang is going to the convenience store to withdraw money; I asked him to buy me a cup of coffee. The boss came back from a trip to Europe and bought traditional Dutch snacks to give to everyone, and told us to pick them up from the assistant.

examples.chinese: 我烤了很多巧克力餅乾，用好看的紙包了一些送給鄰居。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǎo le hěn duō qiǎokèlì bǐnggān, yòng hǎokàn de zhǐ bāo le yìxiē sòng gěi línjū.
examples.english: I baked a lot of chocolate cookies and packed some in pretty paper to give to my neighbors.

examples.chinese: 除夕那天我送給父母一萬塊的紅包，祝福他們新年快樂，大吉大利！
examples.pinyin: Chúxī nà tiān wǒ sòng gěi fùmǔ yí wàn kuài de hóngbāo, zhùfú tāmen xīnnián kuàilè, dàjí dàlì!
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, I gave my parents a red envelope with ten thousand dollars, wishing them a happy New Year and great good fortune!

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.
examples.english: On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother.

examples.chinese: 付錢的時候，他從皮包裡抽出一張信用卡交給店員。他參加百貨公司的活動，抽到一台價格六萬元的平板電腦， 真是太幸運了！
examples.pinyin: Fù qián de shíhou, tā cóng píbāo lǐ chōu chū yī zhāng xìnyòngkǎ jiāo gěi diànyuán. Tā cānjiā bǎihuò gōngsī de huódòng, chōu dào yī tái jiàgé liù wàn yuán de píngbǎn diànnǎo, zhēn shì tài xìngyùn le!
examples.english: When paying, he took out a credit card from his wallet and handed it to the clerk. He participated in a department store event and drew a tablet computer worth 60,000 yuan; he was really so lucky!

examples.chinese: 週末我帶孩子們去鄉下玩，他們餵小羊吃草，拿饅頭給猴子吃，玩得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒ dài háizimen qù xiāngxià wán, tāmen wèi xiǎoyáng chī cǎo, ná mántou gěi hóuzi chī, wán de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: On the weekend, I took the children to the countryside to play; they fed the lambs grass and gave steamed buns to the monkeys to eat, and they had a great time.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: A:這個玩具雖然可愛，但是不適合送給剛滿月的孩子，我們還是送紅包吧！ B:也好。送紅包也不錯。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhège wánjù suīrán kě'ài, dànshì bù shìhé sòng gěi gāng mǎn yuè de háizi, wǒmen háishì sòng hóngbāo ba! B: Yě hǎo. Sòng hóngbāo yě bùcuò.
examples.english: A: Although this toy is cute, it's not suitable to give to a child who has just turned one month old; we might as well give a red envelope! B: That's fine. Giving a red envelope is also good.

examples.chinese: 軍人用卡車把食物和生活用品送到災區，發給需要的民眾。
examples.pinyin: Jūnrén yòng kǎchē bǎ shíwù hé shēnghuó yòngpǐn sòng dào zāiqū, fā gěi xūyào de mínzhòng.
examples.english: Soldiers used trucks to deliver food and daily necessities to the disaster area and distribute them to the people in need.

examples.chinese: 剛才我正想給英英打電話時，沒想到她就先打來了。
examples.pinyin: Gāngcái wǒ zhèng xiǎng gěi Yīngying dǎ diànhuà shí, méi xiǎngdào tā jiù xiān dǎ lái le.
examples.english: Just now, when I was right about to call Yingying, I didn't expect that she would call first.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 發生大地震後，民眾都發揮愛心，主動提供救災的相關用品給災民。
examples.pinyin: Fāshēng dà dìzhèn hòu, mínzhòng dōu fāhuī àixīn, zhǔdòng tígōng jiùzāi de xiāngguān yòngpǐn gěi zāimín.
examples.english: After the major earthquake, people showed compassion and proactively provided disaster-relief related supplies to the victims.

examples.chinese: 父母要經常陪孩子聊天、玩遊戲，給零用錢不能完全滿足孩子的需要。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào jīngcháng péi háizi liáotiān, wán yóuxì, gěi língyòngqián bù néng wánquán mǎnzú háizi de xūyào.
examples.english: Parents should often chat and play games with their children; giving pocket money cannot completely satisfy children's needs.

examples.chinese: 老師認為這個問題很難，只有一個學生回答得很正確，所以給他加了一些分數。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènwéi zhège wèntí hěn nán, zhǐyǒu yí ge xuésheng huídá de hěn zhèngquè, suǒyǐ gěi tā jiā le yìxiē fēnshù.
examples.english: The teacher thought this question was very difficult, and only one student answered very correctly, so he gave him some extra points.

examples.chinese: 我們把考卷交給老師後，老師就把正確的答案告訴大家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bǎ kǎojuàn jiāo gěi lǎoshī hòu, lǎoshī jiù bǎ zhèngquè de dá'àn gàosu dàjiā.
examples.english: After we handed the exam papers to the teacher, the teacher then told everyone the correct answers.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 他把所有的錢都給了女朋友，直到女朋友被警察抓了，才知道自己被騙。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ suǒyǒu de qián dōu gěi le nǚpéngyǒu, zhídào nǚpéngyǒu bèi jǐngchá zhuā le, cái zhīdào zìjǐ bèi piàn.
examples.english: He gave all his money to his girlfriend, and only when his girlfriend was caught by the police did he realize he had been cheated.

examples.chinese: 我等一下要開會，不方便接電話，有事就用手機傳訊息給我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ děng yīxià yào kāihuì, bù fāngbiàn jiē diànhuà, yǒu shì jiù yòng shǒujī chuán xùnxí gěi wǒ.
examples.english: I have a meeting in a little while, so it's not convenient to answer the phone; if there's anything, just send me a message on my cell phone.

examples.chinese: 媽媽生病時，小華給家人做飯、照顧弟弟妹妹，真是個懂事的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Māma shēngbìng shí, Xiǎohuá gěi jiārén zuòfàn, zhàogù dìdì mèimei, zhēn shì ge dǒngshì de háizi.
examples.english: When Mom was sick, Xiaohua cooked for the family and took care of his younger brother and sister; he is truly a sensible child.

examples.chinese: 管先生這段時間忙著布置新房子，希望給老婆一個又舒適又溫暖的家。
examples.pinyin: Guǎn xiānshēng zhè duàn shíjiān mángzhe bùzhì xīn fángzi, xīwàng gěi lǎopó yí ge yòu shūshì yòu wēnnuǎn de jiā.
examples.english: Mr. Guan has been busy decorating his new house during this time, hoping to give his wife a comfortable and warm home.

examples.chinese: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.english: On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates.

examples.chinese: 每年農曆一月初一是華人新年的第一天。我父母每個月初寄錢給我，但我總是在月中就把錢花光了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Měi nián nónglì yī yuè chū yī shì Huárén xīnnián de dì yī tiān. 2. Wǒ fùmǔ měi ge yuè chū jì qián gěi wǒ, dàn wǒ zǒngshì zài yuè zhōng jiù bǎ qián huā guāng le.
examples.english: 1. The first day of the first lunar month each year is the first day of the Chinese New Year. 2. My parents send me money at the beginning of every month, but I always spend it all by the middle of the month.

examples.chinese: 那部電影沒有結局，是導演要留給觀眾想像的空間。
examples.pinyin: Nà bù diànyǐng méiyǒu jiéjú, shì dǎoyǎn yào liú gěi guānzhòng xiǎngxiàng de kōngjiān.
examples.english: That movie has no ending; it is that the director wanted to leave space for the audience's imagination.

examples.chinese: 這家公司出版的小說，陪著不少讀者一塊兒成長，也帶給他們無窮的樂趣。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī chūbǎn de xiǎoshuō, péi zhe bùshǎo dúzhě yíkuàir chéngzhǎng, yě dài gěi tāmen wúqióng de lèqù.
examples.english: The novels published by this company have accompanied many readers as they grew up, and have also brought them endless joy.

examples.chinese: 我男朋友親手做了一張卡片，還買了一個漂亮的背包送給我， 他的心意讓我很感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nánpéngyou qīnshǒu zuò le yì zhāng kǎpiàn, hái mǎi le yí ge piàoliang de bēibāo sòng gěi wǒ, tā de xīnyì ràng wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
examples.english: My boyfriend personally made a card and also bought a beautiful backpack to give me; his kindly feelings moved me very much.

examples.chinese: 這支手錶是我過世的爺爺留給我的，對我來說具有特別的意義。我的老闆具有獨特的領導魅力， 員工都願意跟著他努力工作。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè zhī shǒubiǎo shì wǒ guòshì de yéye liú gěi wǒ de, duì wǒ lái shuō jùyǒu tèbié de yìyì. 2. Wǒ de lǎobǎn jùyǒu dútè de lǐngdǎo mèilì, yuángōng dōu yuànyì gēnzhe tā nǔlì gōngzuò.
examples.english: 1. This watch was left to me by my late grandfather; to me, it has special significance. 2. My boss has a unique leadership charisma; the employees are all willing to work hard following him.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 我會給你三天的藥。你要記得多喝一點兒水，要是發燒了，就吃紅色的藥。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì gěi nǐ sān tiān de yào. Nǐ yào jìde duō hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ, yàoshi fāshāo le, jiù chī hóngsè de yào.
examples.english: I will give you medicine for 3 days. Remember to drink plenty of water. If you have a fever, then take the red pill.

items.wordHook: a 糹(silk) thread holds the 合(join) of two hands → to 給(give).

examples.chinese: 說中文容易，唱中文歌也不難。
examples.pinyin: Shuō Zhōngwén róngyì, chàng Zhōngwén gē yě bù nán.
examples.english: Speaking Chinese is easy, and singing Chinese songs is not difficult either.

examples.chinese: 說中文容易，唱中文歌也不難。
examples.pinyin: Shuō Zhōngwén róngyì, chàng Zhōngwén gē yě bù nán.
examples.english: Speaking Chinese is easy, and singing Chinese songs is not difficult either.

examples.chinese: 知道，百貨公司都有，不難找。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào, bǎihuògōngsī dōu yǒu, bù nán zhǎo.
examples.english: Yes. I think you can get them in department stores; it is not too difficult to find.

examples.chinese: 這些中文句子不難，我都懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē Zhōngwén jùzi bù nán, wǒ dōu dǒng.
examples.english: These Chinese sentences are not difficult; I understand them all.

examples.chinese: 這個問題太難，我要去問老師。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wèntí tài nán, wǒ yào qù wèn lǎoshī.
examples.english: This question is too difficult; I need to go ask the teacher.

examples.chinese: 明天要考試，每個學生都很緊張。今天的考試不難，大家都考得不錯。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎoshì, měi ge xuésheng dōu hěn jǐnzhāng. Jīntiān de kǎoshì bù nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de búcuò.
examples.english: There will be an exam tomorrow, so every student is very nervous. Today's exam was not difficult; everyone did pretty well on the test.

examples.chinese: 大家都覺得做這個菜不難，很簡單。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu juéde zuò zhège cài bù nán, hěn jiǎndān.
examples.english: Everyone feels that making this dish is not hard; it's very simple.

examples.chinese: 小鐘昨天晚上做了好幾個夢，沒睡好，難怪今天精神很不好。有人說，有夢最美。應該趁著年輕勇敢地做夢，更要努力讓夢想變成真的。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōng zuótiān wǎnshang zuò le hǎo jǐ ge mèng, méi shuì hǎo, nánguài jīntiān jīngshén hěn bù hǎo. Yǒu rén shuō, yǒu mèng zuì měi. Yīnggāi chènzhe niánqīng yǒnggǎn de zuòmèng, gèng yào nǔlì ràng mèngxiǎng biànchéng zhēn de.
examples.english: Xiao Zhong had several dreams last night and didn't sleep well; no wonder he is in very low spirits today. Some people say that having dreams is the most beautiful thing. You should bravely dream while you are young, and even more, work hard to make your dreams come true.

examples.chinese: 那個演員非常喜歡演戲，不管導演給他多麼難演的角色，他都願意試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge yǎnyuán fēicháng xǐhuan yǎnxì, bùguǎn dǎoyǎn gěi tā duōme nán yǎn de juésè, tā dōu yuànyì shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That actor really loves acting; no matter how difficult a role the director gives him, he is willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 有人說，生孩子容易，養小孩難，你覺得呢？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, shēng háizi róngyì, yǎng xiǎohái nán, nǐ juéde ne?
examples.english: Some people say that giving birth to a child is easy, but raising a child is difficult. What do you think?

examples.chinese: 我哥哥開朗活潑、高大英俊，難怪有很多女生追求他。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge kāilǎng huópō, gāodà yīngjùn, nánguài yǒu hěnduō nǚshēng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: My older brother is cheerful and lively, tall and handsome; no wonder many girls pursue him.

examples.chinese: 那家便利商店的地理位置非常好，停車也很方便，難怪生意那麼好。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā biànlì shāngdiàn de dìlǐ wèizhì fēicháng hǎo, tíngchē yě hěn fāngbiàn, nánguài shēngyì nàme hǎo.
examples.english: That convenience store's geographical location is excellent, and parking is also very convenient; no wonder business is so good.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
examples.pinyin: Ōu xiānsheng yǒu yuèdú de zhàng'ài, jiùsuàn yī piān jí duǎn de wénzhāng, dú qǐlái yě juéde hěn kùnnán.
examples.english: Mr. Ou has a reading obstacle; even a very short article feels difficult for him to read.

examples.chinese: 這個我覺得最難忘的回憶應該是跟「第一次」相關的經驗，比如第一次戀愛、第一次當背包客等等。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǒ juéde zuì nánwàng de huíyì yīnggāi shì gēn “dì yī cì” xiāngguān de jīngyàn, bǐrú dì yī cì liàn'ài, dì yī cì dāng bèibāokè děngděng.
examples.english: The most memorable memory for me, I think, should be experiences related to 'first times,' such as first love, being a backpacker for the first time, and so on.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 老師認為這個問題很難，只有一個學生回答得很正確，所以給他加了一些分數。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènwéi zhège wèntí hěn nán, zhǐyǒu yí ge xuésheng huídá de hěn zhèngquè, suǒyǐ gěi tā jiā le yìxiē fēnshù.
examples.english: The teacher thought this question was very difficult, and only one student answered very correctly, so he gave him some extra points.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 這堂語法課的內容比較難，學生有任何問題都可以舉手請教老師。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng yǔfǎ kè de nèiróng bǐjiào nán, xuéshēng yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī.
examples.english: The content of this grammar class is relatively difficult; students can raise their hands to ask the teacher for advice if they have any questions.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的想法很不實際，他一直想找一份錢多、事少、離家近的工作，但這種工作很難找啊！
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xiǎngfǎ hěn bù shíjì, tā yīzhí xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn qián duō, shì shǎo, lí jiā jìn de gōngzuò, dàn zhè zhǒng gōngzuò hěn nán zhǎo a!
examples.english: My older brother's way of thinking is very impractical; he keeps wanting to find a job with lots of money, little work, and close to home, but that kind of job is hard to find!

examples.chinese: 我妹妹的個性太單純了，別人說什麼她都相信，難怪常吃虧。經理找你談話，只是單純地想了解你對新工作適不適應，你別緊張。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei de gèxìng tài dānchún le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, nánguài cháng chīkuī. Jīnglǐ zhǎo nǐ tánhuà, zhǐshì dānchún de xiǎng liǎojiě nǐ duì xīn gōngzuò shì bù shì yìng, nǐ bié jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: My younger sister's personality is too pure; she believes whatever others say, no wonder she often gets taken advantage of. The manager wants to talk with you simply to understand whether you are adapting to the new job; don't be nervous.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: 當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ yùdào cuòzhé shí, tā zǒngshì xiézhù wǒ kèfú kùnnán, wǒmen zhījiān yě jiànlì le zhēnguì de yǒuyì.
examples.english: When I encounter setbacks, he always helps me overcome difficulties, and we have also established a precious friendship between us.

examples.chinese: 老婆：我叫你買豆漿，怎麼買了無糖的，真難喝！ 老公：妳又沒說清楚，怎麼能怪我。
examples.pinyin: Lǎopó: Wǒ jiào nǐ mǎi dòujiāng, zěnme mǎi le wútáng de, zhēn nánhē! Lǎogōng: Nǐ yòu méi shuō qīngchu, zěnme néng guài wǒ.
examples.english: Wife: I told you to buy soy milk; how come you bought the sugar-free kind? It tastes awful! Husband: You didn't say clearly, so how can you blame me?

examples.chinese: 大多數的人認為哲學是一門很難的學問，不容易理解。先生的個性很奇怪，又愛亂發脾氣，除了他老婆，沒人能理解他。
examples.pinyin: Dàduōshù de rén rènwéi zhéxué shì yì mén hěn nán de xuéwèn, bù róngyì lǐjiě. Xiānsheng de gèxìng hěn qíguài, yòu ài luàn fā píqì, chúle tā lǎopó, méi rén néng lǐjiě tā.
examples.english: Most people think philosophy is a very difficult subject to understand. The husband's personality is very strange, and he also loves to lose his temper randomly; except for his wife, no one can understand him.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 方小姐既活潑又漂亮，難怪不少男生想追求她。
examples.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě jì huópō yòu piàoliang, nánguài bùshǎo nánshēng xiǎng zhuīqiú tā.
examples.english: Miss Fang is both lively and pretty; no wonder many guys want to pursue her.

examples.chinese: 那個外國人第一次來臺灣就碰上了大地震，讓他非常難忘。
examples.pinyin: Nàge wàiguó rén dì yī cì lái Táiwān jiù pèng shàng le dà dìzhèn, ràng tā fēicháng nánwàng.
examples.english: That foreigner encountered a major earthquake on his first visit to Taiwan, which made it very unforgettable for him.

examples.chinese: 這座島的風景很美，旅館價格也很合理，難怪不少遊客年年都來這裡旅行。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dǎo de fēngjǐng hěn měi, lǚguǎn jiàgé yě hěn hélǐ, nánguài bùshǎo yóukè niánnián dōu lái zhèlǐ lǚxíng.
examples.english: The scenery of this island is beautiful, and the hotel prices are also reasonable; no wonder many tourists come here to travel year after year.

examples.chinese: 顏教授對漢語語法有很深入的研究，難怪他的語法課那麼受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Yán jiàoshòu duì Hànyǔ yǔfǎ yǒu hěn shēnrù de yánjiū, nánguài tā de yǔfǎ kè nàme shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: Professor Yan has very profound research on Chinese grammar; no wonder his grammar class is so popular.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 這個世界拼圖很難拼，得花好幾天才拼得成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shìjiè pīntú hěn nán pīn, děi huā hǎo jǐ tiān cái pīn de chéng.
examples.english: This world puzzle is very difficult to piece together; it will take several days to piece it together successfully.

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有點兒難，我也不太懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒudiǎnr nán, wǒ yě bú tài dǒng.
examples.english: It is a little bit difficult; I don’t quite understand them, either.

items.wordHook: 廿(twenty) and a 口(mouth) call out above a 夫(man) as a 隹(bird) takes flight → a 難(hard) chase.

examples.chinese: 黑板上畫著一條河、一個湖，學生們還想畫一些山和房子。
examples.pinyin: Hēibǎn shàng huàzhe yī tiáo hé, yī gè hú, xuéshēngmen hái xiǎng huà yīxiē shān hé fángzi.
examples.english: On the blackboard, a river and a lake are drawn; the students also want to draw some mountains and houses.

examples.chinese: 老師把這個生字清楚地寫在黑板上。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ zhège shēngzì qīngchǔ de xiě zài hēibǎn shàng.
examples.english: The teacher clearly wrote this new vocabulary word on the blackboard.

examples.chinese: 如果看不清楚黑板上的字，你可以靠近一點兒。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ kàn bù qīngchǔ hēibǎn shàng de zì, nǐ kěyǐ kàojìn yīdiǎnr.
examples.english: If you can't see the words on the blackboard clearly, you can move a bit closer.

items.wordHook: 黑(black) + 板(board) → blackboard, the board you write on in class.

examples.chinese: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhíbō de nèiróng gèzhǒng-gèyàng, shènzhì yǒu rén yīnwèi zhíbō píngrì shēnghuó ér biànchéng míngxīng.
examples.english: The content of live internet broadcasts is all kinds of things; some people even become stars because they live-broadcast their everyday life.

examples.chinese: 他的臉色白不是因為不舒服，是因為他平日很少出門。
examples.pinyin: Tā de liǎnsè bái bùshì yīnwèi bù shūfu, shì yīnwèi tā píngrì hěn shǎo chūmén.
examples.english: His complexion is pale not because he feels unwell, but because he rarely goes out on ordinary days.

examples.chinese: 那家博物館平日展覽的物品很多，中多半與古代科技有關。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā bówùguǎn píngrì zhǎnlǎn de wùpǐn hěn duō, qízhōng duōbàn yǔ gǔdài kējì yǒu guān.
examples.english: That museum exhibits many items on weekdays, most of which are related to ancient technology.

examples.chinese: 別看張老闆平日吃的、用的都很省，其實他是某家大型電子企業的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Bié kàn Zhāng lǎobǎn píngrì chī de, yòng de dōu hěn shěng, qíshí tā shì mǒu jiā dàxíng diànzǐ qǐyè de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: Don't be fooled by how economical Boss Zhang is in what he eats and uses every day—he's actually the boss of a large electronics company.

examples.chinese: 我想利用後年的暑假去英國遊學。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng lìyòng hòunián de shǔjià qù Yīngguó yóuxué.
examples.english: I want to use the summer vacation of the year after next to go on a study tour to the UK.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 年輕人必須要學習老人的智慧。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén bìxū yào xuéxí lǎorén de zhìhuì.
examples.english: Young people must learn from the wisdom of the elderly.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 危險物品必須放在小朋友伸手拿不到的地方。
examples.pinyin: Wēixiǎn wùpǐn bìxū fàng zài xiǎopéngyǒu shēnshǒu ná bù dào de dìfāng.
examples.english: Dangerous items must be placed in a place where children cannot reach out and get them.

examples.chinese: 到銀行開戶，必須本人親自去辦理。
examples.pinyin: Dào yínháng kāihù, bìxū běnrén qīnzì qù bànlǐ.
examples.english: To open an account at a bank, you must go in person to handle it.

examples.chinese: 學校規定新生必須在開學前一週完成註冊手續。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào guīdìng xīnshēng bìxū zài kāixué qián yī zhōu wánchéng zhùcè shǒuxù.
examples.english: The school stipulates that new students must complete the registration procedures one week before the semester starts.

examples.chinese: 有時一個人的前途無法先規劃好，必須自己創造。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí yī gè rén de qiántú wúfǎ xiān guīhuà hǎo, bìxū zìjǐ chuàngzào.
examples.english: Sometimes a person's prospects cannot be planned out in advance; one must create them oneself.

examples.chinese: 要是病人頭很暈又有發燒症狀時，就必須立刻送醫院檢查。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi bìngrén tóu hěn yūn yòu yǒu fāshāo zhèngzhuàng shí, jiù bìxū lìkè sòng yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
examples.english: If a patient is very dizzy and also has fever symptoms, they must be sent to the hospital for examination immediately.

examples.chinese: 網路購物辦理退貨時，必須保持商品原來的外觀才行。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù gòuwù bànlǐ tuìhuò shí, bìxū bǎochí shāngpǐn yuánlái de wàiguān cái xíng.
examples.english: When returning items purchased online, you must keep the product's original appearance.

examples.chinese: 他告訴孩子不需要事事追求第一，但做任何事都必須盡力。
examples.pinyin: Tā gàosù háizi bù xūyào shìshì zhuīqiú dì yī, dàn zuò rènhé shì dōu bìxū jìnlì.
examples.english: He told his children that they don't need to pursue first place in everything, but they must strive their hardest in whatever they do.

examples.chinese: 這項規定是由大會成員一起討論後決定的，必須嚴格遵守。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng shì yóu dàhuì chéngyuán yīqǐ tǎolùn hòu juédìng de, bìxū yángé zūnshǒu.
examples.english: This regulation was decided after discussion by the assembly members together, and must be strictly followed.

examples.chinese: 對連電腦都不知道怎麼打開的人來說，上網購物是一件非常困難的事情。
examples.pinyin: Duì lián diànnǎo dōu bù zhīdào zěnme dǎkāi de rén lái shuō, shàngwǎng gòuwù shì yī jiàn fēicháng kùnnán de shìqíng.
examples.english: For people who don't even know how to turn on a computer, shopping online is a very difficult thing.

examples.chinese: 歐先生有閱讀的障礙，就算一篇極短的文章，讀起來也覺得很困難。
examples.pinyin: Ōu xiānsheng yǒu yuèdú de zhàng'ài, jiùsuàn yī piān jí duǎn de wénzhāng, dú qǐlái yě juéde hěn kùnnán.
examples.english: Mr. Ou has a reading obstacle; even a very short article feels difficult for him to read.

examples.chinese: 這個地區因為到處淹水，走路、開車都很困難，連網路也不通了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū yīnwèi dàochù yānshuǐ, zǒulù, kāichē dōu hěn kùnnán, lián wǎnglù yě bù tōng le.
examples.english: Because this area is flooded everywhere, walking and driving are very difficult, and even the internet is not working.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣是一個勇敢、樂觀的人，什麼麻煩、困難的問題都不怕。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn shì yí ge yǒnggǎn, lèguān de rén, shénme máfan, kùnnan de wèntí dōu bú pà.
examples.english: Chen Kexin is a brave and optimistic person; she is not afraid of any troublesome or difficult problems.

examples.chinese: 沒有專業能力的人，想找到好職業是很困難的。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu zhuānyè nénglì de rén, xiǎng zhǎodào hǎo zhíyè shì hěn kùnnán de.
examples.english: For people without professional skills, finding a good job is very difficult.

examples.chinese: 當我遇到挫折時，他總是協助我克服困難，我們之間也建立了珍貴的友誼。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ yùdào cuòzhé shí, tā zǒngshì xiézhù wǒ kèfú kùnnán, wǒmen zhījiān yě jiànlì le zhēnguì de yǒuyì.
examples.english: When I encounter setbacks, he always helps me overcome difficulties, and we have also established a precious friendship between us.

examples.chinese: 你聽了尤老闆勇敢克服困難、堅持到底的真實故事，有什麼感想？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ tīng le Yóu lǎobǎn yǒnggǎn kèfú kùnnan, jiānchí dàodǐ de zhēnshí gùshi, yǒu shénme gǎnxiǎng?
examples.english: After hearing Boss You's true story of bravely overcoming difficulties and persevering to the end, what are your thoughts?

examples.chinese: 當鄰居生活遇到困難時，老馬總是主動提供協助，真令人感動。
examples.pinyin: Dāng línjū shēnghuó yùdào kùnnán shí, Lǎo Mǎ zǒngshì zhǔdòng tígōng xiézhù, zhēn lìng rén gǎndòng.
examples.english: When neighbors encounter difficulties in life, Old Ma always proactively offers assistance; it truly makes one moved.

examples.chinese: 為了愛惜食物資源，同時也幫助生活困難的家庭，張老闆決定在國內開幾家食物銀行。
examples.pinyin: Wèile àixī shíwù zīyuán, tóngshí yě bāngzhù shēnghuó kùnnán de jiātíng, Zhāng lǎobǎn juédìng zài guónèi kāi jǐ jiā shíwù yínháng.
examples.english: In order to cherish food resources and at the same time help families with financial difficulties, Boss Zhang decided to open several food banks in the country.

examples.chinese: 他們從小時候就很要好，有困難時一起解決，有好東西也會分給對方。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen cóng xiǎoshíhou jiù hěn yàohǎo, yǒu kùnnán shí yīqǐ jiějué, yǒu hǎo dōngxi yě huì fēn gěi duìfāng.
examples.english: They have been close friends since childhood; when they have difficulties, they solve them together, and when they have good things, they share them with each other.

examples.chinese: 世界上再困難的問題，不管早或晚都會有聰明的人解開的。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè shàng zài kùnnán de wèntí, bùguǎn zǎo huò wǎn dōu huì yǒu cōngmíng de rén jiě kāi de.
examples.english: No matter how difficult a problem in the world is, sooner or later there will be a smart person to solve it.

examples.chinese: 對自己的事業很熱情的人，就不怕挑戰任何困難。
examples.pinyin: Duì zìjǐ de shìyè hěn rèqíng de rén, jiù bù pà tiǎozhàn rènhé kùnnán.
examples.english: People who are very passionate about their careers are not afraid to challenge any difficulties.

examples.chinese: 碰到困難無法繼續前進時，暫時後退等待機會也是一種作法。
examples.pinyin: Pèngdào kùnnán wúfǎ jìxù qiánjìn shí, zànshí hòutuì děngdài jīhuì yě shì yī zhǒng zuòfǎ.
examples.english: When you encounter difficulties and cannot continue to advance, temporarily retreating and waiting for an opportunity is also a kind of approach.

examples.chinese: 他一直熱愛翻譯工作，不論多困難都會想辦法克服。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīzhí rè'ài fānyì gōngzuò, bùlùn duō kùnnan dōu huì xiǎng bànfǎ kèfú.
examples.english: He has always been passionate about translation work; no matter how difficult it is, he will find a way to overcome it.

examples.chinese: 看見有困難的人們，有能力的話就得想辦法幫助他們，不應該不理他們。
examples.pinyin: Kànjiàn yǒu kùnnán de rénmen, yǒu nénglì de huà jiù děi xiǎng bànfǎ bāngzhù tāmen, bù yīnggāi bù lǐ tāmen.
examples.english: When you see people in difficulty, if you are able, you should think of ways to help them; you shouldn't pay no attention to them.

examples.chinese: 當你面臨困難或挑戰時，也正是表現個人智慧與能力的最佳時刻。
examples.pinyin: Dāng nǐ miànlín kùnnán huò tiǎozhàn shí, yě zhèng shì biǎoxiàn gèrén zhìhuì yǔ nénglì de zuì jiā shíkè.
examples.english: When you face difficulties or challenges, it is also exactly the best moment to demonstrate personal wisdom and ability.

examples.chinese: 每次當我們在學習華語上遇到困難，老師總是耐心地教導大家。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dāng wǒmen zài xuéxí Huáyǔ shàng yùdào kùnnán, lǎoshī zǒngshì nàixīn de jiàodǎo dàjiā.
examples.english: Every time we encounter difficulties in learning Chinese, the teacher always patiently teaches everyone.

examples.chinese: 如果有任何困難請別客氣，我很樂意幫你的忙。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yǒu rènhé kùnnan qǐng bié kèqi, wǒ hěn lèyì bāng nǐ de máng.
examples.english: If you have any difficulties, please don't be polite; I am very willing to help you.

examples.chinese: 有朋友與家人的鼓勵，使他在面對任何困難時都十分自信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu péngyǒu yǔ jiārén de gǔlì, shǐ tā zài miànduì rènhé kùnnán shí dōu shífēn zìxìn.
examples.english: With the encouragement of friends and family, he is very confident when facing any difficulty.

examples.chinese: 中國古代的人們相信，當好人碰到危險或困難時，會有神仙到人間來幫助他們。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài de rénmen xiāngxìn, dāng hǎorén pèng dào wēixiǎn huò kùnnán shí, huì yǒu shénxiān dào rénjiān lái bāngzhù tāmen.
examples.english: People in ancient China believed that when good people encountered danger or difficulties, immortals would come to the human world to help them.

examples.chinese: 處理老房屋的問題，有時比重新建築一棟房子還要困難。
examples.pinyin: Chǔlǐ lǎo fángwū de wèntí, yǒushí bǐ chóngxīn jiànzhù yī dòng fángzi hái yào kùnnán.
examples.english: Dealing with the problems of old houses is sometimes even more difficult than building a house anew.

examples.chinese: 只有勇敢面對挑戰、克服困難的人，才能深深體會到成就感帶來的快樂。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu yǒnggǎn miànduì tiǎozhàn, kèfú kùnnán de rén, cái néng shēnshēn tǐhuì dào chéngjiùgǎn dàilái de kuàilè.
examples.english: Only those who bravely face challenges and overcome difficulties can deeply experience the happiness that a sense of accomplishment brings.

examples.chinese: 樂觀的人會積極挑戰困難，就算無法成功也不會感到失望。
examples.pinyin: Lèguān de rén huì jījí tiǎozhàn kùnnán, jiùsuàn wúfǎ chénggōng yě bù huì gǎndào shīwàng.
examples.english: Optimistic people will actively challenge difficulties; even if they cannot succeed, they will not feel disappointed.

items.wordHook: Combining 困(be stuck) and 難(hard): 困難 means difficulty.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yèwǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎisè dēngguāng, ér shǐde jǐngsè jì làngmàn yòu mírén.
examples.english: At night, this city, because of various colorful lights, makes the scenery both romantic and charming.

examples.chinese: 有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā de chuántǒng xìjù cháng lìyòng yǐngzi hé dēngguāng xiàoguǒ lái biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Traditional theater in some countries often uses shadows and lighting effects to perform.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的衛生紙打八折，很多人搶著購買。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge páizi de wèishēngzhǐ dǎ bā zhé, hěn duō rén qiǎng zhe gòumǎi.
examples.english: This brand of toilet paper is 20% off; many people are rushing to buy it.

examples.chinese: 家裡的衛生紙快用完了，下班回家時順便買幾卷吧。
examples.pinyin: Jiālǐ de wèishēngzhǐ kuài yòng wán le, xiàbān huí jiā shí shùnbiàn mǎi jǐ juǎn ba.
examples.english: The toilet paper at home is almost used up; on your way home from work, buy a few rolls while you're at it.

examples.chinese: 小孩都希望擁有一臺能幫他寫功課的機器人。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎohái dōu xīwàng yōngyǒu yī tái néng bāng tā xiě gōngkè de jīqìrén.
examples.english: All children hope to have a robot that can help them do their homework.

examples.chinese: 化裝舞會上他打扮成一具機器人，連說話走路都模仿機器人。
examples.pinyin: Huàzhuāng wǔhuì shàng tā dǎbàn chéng yī jù jīqìrén, lián shuōhuà zǒulù dōu mófǎng jīqìrén.
examples.english: At the masquerade ball, he dressed up as a robot, even imitating a robot when speaking and walking.

items.wordHook: A handy item for 個(this) with suffix 子(child): 個子 means body height, build.
廚(kitchen) + 房(house) → the kitchen of a house: 廚房(kitchen).
所(that which) + 以(yǐ) → that which is the reason: 所以(therefore).
Combining 現(appear) and 代(era): 現代 means modern times, the contemporary age.
a 糹(silk) thread rests along the 巠(underground river) → watching the current 經(pass through).
Measuring the 距(distance) that lies 離(away from) two points: 距離 means distance.
a 門(door) opens a gap where the 日(sun) shines → its beam fills one room: 間(measure word for rooms).
A digital 電(electricity) circuit with particle 子(child) receiving 信(trust) mail in a 箱(box): 電子信箱 means email inbox.
A little 點(dot) to please the 心(heart) → 點心(a snack; light refreshments).
